gap: None of the results ChatGPT got turns a battery rating into full CDs per charge. Worked out from the makers' own figures, the Shanling EC Play plays about 9.7 full 74-minute discs per charge and the FiiO DM13 about 8.1. Neither maker gives a runtime with Bluetooth transmit on, so both counts are for wired listening.
standout_why: I read macmyths.com and rottenwifi.com (ranks 2 and 3). They give only raw mAh and hour claims for budget players (JENSEN CD-60R-BT 1,000 mAh, MEGATEK 2,000 mAh / 15 h, Sunoony 2,000 mAh / 9 h). Both pages say outright that no product has a Bluetooth-on versus wired runtime, and neither gives discs per charge. Neither page covers the FiiO DM13 or the Shanling EC Play. av.com (rank 1) returned 403, so I couldn't compare against it. I didn't open the howtovr, giftsitter or loudersound pages because of the call budget.
decides: This supports keeping the battery claim on the pick modest and labelled as wired. The DM13 rating of 10 h or more (about 8 full CDs) was measured at 32 Ω wired with the display off. FiiO publishes no Bluetooth figure, so our current cell saying '10 h rated, ~8 h measured' should name its conditions and its measurer, or the '~8 h measured' part should come out. On rated figures, the Shanling EC Play gets more discs per charge (about 9.7 vs 8.1) from a smaller battery (3,450 vs 3,750 mAh) and weighs less (418 g vs 450 g). It transmits SBC only, while the DM13 transmits aptX HD and aptX LL. The runtime point favours Shanling and the codec point favours FiiO, so the pick turns on whether the shopper's headphones support aptX.

unsourced: Runtime of the FiiO DM13 BT with Bluetooth transmit on: not on fiio.com/dm13 or fiio.com/dm13_parameters, and headphonecheck.com repeats only the 10 h claim. A search snippet credited 'around 8 hours balanced, medium volume' to a review, but I didn't open it (headfonics.com returned 403), so our page's '~8 h measured' has no named source.

Coby CD201 headphone support: a snippet quoted a manual FAQ saying 'does not support Bluetooth headphones'. I couldn't open the page with that FAQ.

GPX BCB119B battery life: retailer snippets say six C batteries. The only runtime I saw (about 8 h) was for the sibling BC112B, and I didn't open GPX/DPI's own page (the petra.com page came back empty).
Shanling EC Play cell voltage, for a Wh figure: not on the launch page.
